goals.name: Lock references and acceptance
goals.exit: Approve the visual target, evidence rules and test workloads before authorizing implementation.

goals.name: Unified spatial data foundation
goals.exit: One versioned contract preserves identity, geometry meaning, coordinates and optional attachments across sources.

goals.name: Scene compiler and streamed foundation
goals.exit: The same contract creates reusable, identifiable render assets and a minimal tiled viewport.

goals.name: Complete-map visual fidelity
goals.exit: An actual full neighbourhood meets the primary mockup quality across several camera angles.

goals.name: Cross-area consistency and scale
goals.exit: Different datasets stream together without identity, measurement, style or memory regressions.

goals.name: Map workspace UI
goals.exit: Add the benchmarked map shell and navigation after the scene-quality gates pass.

goals.name: Building, floor, unit and optional evidence UI
goals.exit: Linked inspections reuse one model and work with no documents attached.

goals.name: Multi-source import and editing UI
goals.exit: Operators normalize, reconcile, edit and publish revisioned changes without a second data model.

goals.name: Release hardening and expansion
goals.exit: Regression, accessibility, privacy, operational recovery and held-out datasets qualify a reproducible release.

tasks.title: Approve reference manifest and screen mapping
tasks.deliverable: Hash-addressed reference map and canonical screen names
tasks.acceptance: Review the three anchors and supporting states; resolve misleading filenames and image data contradictions.

tasks.title: Approve visual rubric and camera suite
tasks.deliverable: Scored rubric, crop masks and fixed camera/viewport profiles
tasks.acceptance: Separate scene and UI scores; require every critical dimension to pass and user sign-off for each primary state.

tasks.title: Inventory reusable product capabilities
tasks.acceptance: List existing APIs, entities, IDs, scene assets, tests and legacy routes; record actual base commit and uncommitted changes.

tasks.title: Define fixture and held-out dataset suite
tasks.deliverable: F01-F09 fixture specifications with expected properties
tasks.acceptance: Include dense, sloped, sparse, courtyard, cross-boundary and partial-data scenes; keep one external hold-out unseen by generator authors.

tasks.title: Declare hardware and benchmark workload
tasks.deliverable: Device, browser, DPR, network and camera-path profiles
tasks.acceptance: Separate warm/cold loading and rendering profiles; numerical budgets are proposed targets, never historical results.

tasks.title: Approve renderer-first architecture and scope
tasks.deliverable: Decision record and implementation authorization checkpoint
tasks.acceptance: Agree one globe renderer, canonical storage boundary, map-first milestone, optional documents and explicit non-goals.

tasks.title: Define identities, features and spatial relationships
tasks.acceptance: Buildings cross areas/parcels; duplex units span levels; IDs survive movement, renaming, tile splits and reimports.

tasks.title: Define geometry roles and measurement capabilities
tasks.acceptance: Distinguish ground footprint, roof projection, rights boundary, exterior and display mesh; unsupported quantities return unavailable.

tasks.title: Define coordinate and vertical-reference rules
tasks.deliverable: Frame/transform registry and numerical test vectors
tasks.acceptance: Explicit units/axes/height reference; known synthetic transforms round-trip within budget; unknown placement is not placed at origin.

tasks.title: Define provenance and optional attachment links
tasks.acceptance: A building, floor and unit work with zero PDFs; direct and inherited links are distinct; no documents are required merely to view geometry.

tasks.title: Define revision, scenario and publication snapshots
tasks.acceptance: Synthetic and observed scenarios cannot silently mix; a scene manifest binds compatible geometry and metadata revisions.

tasks.title: Normalize existing records and first input adapters
tasks.deliverable: Adapters for current records, canonical JSON, GeoJSON and CSV schedules
tasks.acceptance: Equivalent supported inputs normalize to equivalent quantities; original bytes, unmapped attributes and item-level failures are preserved.

tasks.title: Implement purpose-specific validation and readiness
tasks.acceptance: Partial valid features are not blocked by unrelated missing PDFs; unknown height stays unknown; no repair is silently accepted.

tasks.title: Publish canonical contract conformance fixtures
tasks.acceptance: Zero-document case, holes, invalid polygons, missing datum, conflicting sources and repeated imports all produce expected outcomes.

tasks.title: Define render recipe and asset derivation contract
tasks.deliverable: Scene compiler specification and cache keys
tasks.acceptance: The same geometry/style/compiler revisions produce stable geometry and appearance; seeds use entity/component IDs, not tile position.

tasks.title: Build polygon and part-aware massing
tasks.acceptance: Concave outlines, courtyards, multipart buildings and supported height profiles preserve their modeled extents; no bounding-box substitution.

tasks.title: Build road, ground and network geometry
tasks.acceptance: Variable widths, junctions, terrain, bridges and supported utility profiles are represented without inventing missing dimensions.

tasks.title: Build material and architecture recipe library
tasks.deliverable: Versioned PBR materials, facade rules and reusable parts
tasks.acceptance: Material scale is metric; party walls do not receive arbitrary balconies; optional inferred detail is labelled and excluded from analytical geometry.

tasks.title: Define tile packing, feature metadata and LODs
tasks.deliverable: 3D Tiles/glTF package profile and feature-ID map
tasks.acceptance: Several spatial tiles retain canonical IDs; coarser LODs preserve intended silhouettes and declared error; interiors are separate on-demand content.

tasks.title: Integrate minimal streamed viewport
tasks.deliverable: Cesium-based render harness in the existing app boundary
tasks.acceptance: Load a small tileset, pan/orbit/zoom and pick IDs; no full-area all-feature array is required for world rendering.

tasks.title: Add measurement probes and inspection overlays
tasks.deliverable: Exact-geometry probe, ground scale and test overlays
tasks.acceptance: Numbers come from named canonical revisions; display offsets/LOD changes cannot change values; ambiguous or unloaded exact geometry is explicit.

tasks.title: Qualify renderer and metadata compatibility
tasks.acceptance: Confirm materials, picking, clipping, tiling and recovery on the pinned stack; switch engines only on a documented unmet gate, not preference.

tasks.title: Compose the complete reference-style neighbourhood
tasks.acceptance: Neighbourhood content spans multiple tiles, not only one hero building; every asset passes through the common pipeline.

tasks.title: Tune architecture detail and silhouette variation
tasks.acceptance: Street and reverse angles show coherent proportions, meaningful variation and no repeated inappropriate details or structural inventions.

tasks.title: Tune street, terrain and vegetation appearance
tasks.acceptance: Road junctions and terrain contacts are clean; contextual objects respect known boundaries and do not fill unknown land with decorative parks.

tasks.title: Tune lighting, colour and temporal image quality
tasks.acceptance: No washed-out white geometry, excessive bloom, unreadable shadows, texture shimmer or unstable exposure through the benchmark camera path.

tasks.title: Validate 2D, section and underground render states
tasks.acceptance: All views reference the same geometry; sections are geometric intersections, not guessed thumbnails; unknown utility depth is not buried.

tasks.title: Test dense, slope and sparse-input transfer
tasks.acceptance: No locality-specific code edits; incomplete data has a polished honest fallback; dense lanes retain original modeled width.

tasks.title: Run matched visual comparison and correct failures
tasks.deliverable: Per-view scorecards, unmodified screenshots and camera video
tasks.acceptance: Meet the proposed scene rubric on every required view; prevent one attractive angle from hiding failed reverse/close-up views.

tasks.title: Approve full-map fidelity milestone
tasks.deliverable: Signed visual gate with known limitations
tasks.acceptance: Approve actual browser geometry and replay, not a generated replacement image; no new administrative UI work before this gate.

tasks.title: Implement global scene catalog and coverage queries
tasks.deliverable: Spatial coverage index and versioned manifests
tasks.acceptance: Several areas are discoverable without downloading their feature bodies; overlapping datasets require a deliberate representation policy.

tasks.title: Implement bounded loading, caching and release
tasks.deliverable: Priority loading and bounded CPU/GPU/cache lifecycle
tasks.acceptance: Cancel obsolete requests, retain coarse fallback until replacements load, budget all active tilesets and release unused resources.

tasks.title: Test seams, shared objects and precision across areas
tasks.deliverable: F07 boundary and transform regression suite
tasks.acceptance: No duplicate pick identities, cracks, double roads or changing measurements across tile/area/CRS boundaries; building interiors replace their exterior coherently.

tasks.title: Implement incremental compilation and atomic publication
tasks.deliverable: Dirty-feature/tile dependency graph and rollback manifest
tasks.acceptance: Editing one building rebuilds affected content and neighbour dependencies only; clients never combine half-published incompatible snapshots.

tasks.title: Run scale, failure and held-out stress suites
tasks.deliverable: F08-F09 results with resource and timing traces
tasks.acceptance: 10k/100k synthetic catalogs first; test 1M later without claiming universal scale. Include rapid travel, failures, memory plateau and context loss.

tasks.title: Approve cross-area renderer milestone
tasks.deliverable: Renderer release candidate and conformance profile
tasks.acceptance: Map passes fidelity, quantity, identity, streamed-loading and unseen-input gates simultaneously; exceptions remain explicit.

tasks.title: Build map shell and reusable UI tokens
tasks.acceptance: Match primary map composition at 1672x941 and 1920x1080 while keeping the real scene dominant; do not embed reference images.

tasks.title: Build camera, layer and global-search UI
tasks.acceptance: Search resolves unloaded areas without loading the world; mode and camera agree; basic gestures remain stable through state updates.

tasks.title: Build property list and contextual inspector
tasks.acceptance: Rapid selection and tile unload preserve the correct entity; displayed metrics identify their definitions and revisions.

tasks.title: Build map findings and utility inspection
tasks.acceptance: Highlight exact analytical results, not whole-building substitutes; partial visibility never means complete check coverage.

tasks.title: Build map history, exports and responsive panels
tasks.deliverable: UI-06 history/export and UI-07 mobile shell
tasks.acceptance: Read-only history preserves snapshot identity; exports preserve scenario/provenance; panels and dialogs leave controls reachable.

tasks.title: Approve map UI visual and interaction suite
tasks.acceptance: Every map state has a pinned reference or approved derivative; missing/error/loading states pass usability and correctness checks.

tasks.title: Build building detail and register composition
tasks.acceptance: Match reference layout with a live preview; exterior-only buildings work and missing interior records are not fabricated.

tasks.title: Build floor, flat and shared-space inspection
tasks.acceptance: Unit selection agrees across map, floor, table and plan; multi-level units and shared spaces are represented without double counting.

tasks.title: Build section and exploded inspection controls
tasks.acceptance: Exploded offsets never alter stored geometry or quantities; section station, cut direction and vertical reference are explicit.

tasks.title: Build optional source attachments and viewers
tasks.acceptance: Attach zero, one or many sources at building/floor/unit level; show direct/inherited scope; deleting a link does not delete geometry or another link.

tasks.title: Build record history and investigation surfaces
tasks.acceptance: Use existing authoritative workflows; unknown or missing evidence is not silently resolved; history remains navigable by stable IDs.

tasks.title: Approve inspection and zero-document cases
tasks.acceptance: All inspection views match one canonical snapshot and pass with no PDFs, partial evidence and restricted attachments.

tasks.title: Build import mapping, preview and reconciliation UI
tasks.acceptance: Supported formats show mapping and item-level errors; repeated inputs are idempotent and competing observations are not silently merged.

tasks.title: Build source workspace, calibration and placement
tasks.acceptance: Scale, orientation and geographic/vertical placement are distinct; source viewing does not require valid spatial placement.

tasks.title: Build versioned geometry and attribute editing
tasks.deliverable: UI-15 edit workflow and shared boundaries
tasks.acceptance: Save explicit drafts with revision checks; undo/redo and concurrent edits are safe; editing imported measured geometry requires a deliberate revision.

tasks.title: Build compare, build, review and publish UI
tasks.acceptance: Current data stays visible until a new accepted snapshot and derivatives are ready; stale proposals cannot overwrite newer work.

tasks.title: Expand tested adapters in bounded batches
tasks.acceptance: Each adapter declares version, capabilities, unsupported fields, transformations and test fixtures; unsupported imports are retained/rejected honestly.

tasks.title: Approve edit and adapter conformance suite
tasks.acceptance: Equivalent supported inputs yield consistent representations and quantities; attachment, style and geometry revisions invalidate only their dependencies.

tasks.title: Run all-state visual and interaction regression
tasks.acceptance: Re-run every gate after final changes; old passing reports are not relabelled as current verification.

tasks.title: Qualify browser, accessibility and device tiers
tasks.acceptance: Keyboard and reduced motion work; test real touch hardware; unsupported visual features degrade explicitly without changing geometry.

tasks.title: Qualify permissions, source safety and attribution
tasks.acceptance: Restricted names/PDFs never leak through tile metadata or public caches; hostile imports cannot invoke commands or unrestricted network access.

tasks.title: Qualify operations, deployment and offline packs
tasks.deliverable: Reproducible build, recovery and offline package protocol
tasks.acceptance: Restore DB and assets coherently; retain attribution; network failures, expired URLs and interrupted publication have tested recovery.

tasks.title: Expand scale only against measured capacity
tasks.acceptance: Publish exact hardware/dataset/network evidence; large catalog size alone is not proof of large visible-scene performance.

tasks.title: Approve release and ongoing regression baseline
tasks.deliverable: Versioned release checklist and deferred-work ledger
tasks.acceptance: No P0 blocker, silent synthetic geometry, data-loss path or unmatched primary screen is waived by an average score.
